name: skills
one_liner: A catalog of pre-built instruction packages ('skills') that teach OpenAI's Codex AI assistant how to do specific tasks — though the repo itself now says it is deprecated in favor of a newer one.
buyer: None currently — this repository has been officially deprecated by OpenAI in favor of the 'openai/plugins' repository, so there's no ongoing product to build a business around here.
business_use_cases: None — this repository is explicitly deprecated by OpenAI in favor of openai/plugins, so there's no forward path to build on.
If you need Codex skills, look at the successor repo directly instead of this one.

money_ideas.idea: No viable business idea here — redirect any effort to the maintained successor repository instead of building on deprecated code.

steal_this: Skip it — go straight to openai/plugins for the current, maintained equivalent.
